# Error-envelope budget for the management surface, measured 2026-11-01.
#
# Each line is `<scope> <counter> <n>`. A number may only go down; when it does,
# the gate fails until the file is updated, so the file can never quietly
# describe code that no longer exists.
#
#   uncoded  error responses with no stable `code`
#   chinese  hard-coded Chinese prose on the error path — English by the end of
#            the round, once the language packs carry the translated codes
#
# The starting point of this file was 184 uncoded / 49 Chinese. The 184 are gone;
# Chinese rose to 53 because writeGuard and writeLogged put prose that used to
# travel through a variable back into a literal, where the gate can see it.
adminapi uncoded 0
adminapi chinese 53
